absolute_viability_gates.interpretation: historical-development viability only; passing does not establish independent validation or a tradable system

admission.flat_range: open-position and body features NaN; log-range equals 0 when High == Low > 0

feature_formulas.session_body_signed_range: if finite valid Open/Close/High/Low and High > Low: (Close - Open) / (High - Low); else NaN
feature_formulas.session_log_high_low_range: if finite High >= Low > 0: log(High / Low); else NaN
feature_formulas.session_open_position_range: if finite valid Open/High/Low and High > Low: (Open - Low) / (High - Low); else NaN

challenger.selection_reason: bounded non-redundant completed-session geometry is causally available at EOD t, has accepted Open coverage, and avoids the unresolved long-window corporate-action continuity risk of Structure-Lite

challenger_incremental_promotion_gates.comparison_support: paired exact same validation dates and target-observable row support; Top30 deltas require both models' date metrics to be individually admissible

control.note: the representation is retained as the initial control only; old target, fitted model, performance magnitude, and final-alpha status are not inherited
control.representation: exact Clean-V2 25-column contextual information representation on the frozen primary-liquid universe

decision_logic.legacy_clean_v2: contextual benchmark only; not promotion control and not allowed to override V4 gates

decision_universe.freeze_reason: preserves the clean contextual V2 decision-universe baseline without optimizing a new liquidity threshold on V4 outcomes
decision_universe.listing_and_activity: authoritative PIT common share, LISTED and ACTIVE at EOD t

bootstrap.algorithm: within each 100-date fold, sample 10 non-circular contiguous 10-date blocks with replacement from starts 0..90; concatenate six resampled folds; compute the statistic; repeat 2000 times

forbidden_after_target_access: change H5/H10 definitions or 50/50 consensus weight
change validation tail-600 rule, fold count, fold size, purge, Top30, or observability gates
add/remove/redefine geometry features or test a subset
replace the challenger with Structure-Lite or another information block
add a ranking-native learner as rescue
change absolute or incremental promotion thresholds
choose alternative metrics/shortlist sizes/folds because the frozen result is weak

learner.environment_gate: before first fit, pin exact Python/numpy/pandas/scikit-learn versions and verify estimator signature/effective parameters; package-version choice may not be changed after any V4 target/performance access

legacy_benchmark.admission: only pre-existing genuinely out-of-sample scores on the exact V4 validation dates may be evaluated; a final refit trained through those dates is prohibited

pre_fit_hard_gates: exact six fold identities and official-session purge boundaries materialized and hash-pinned
restored signal-research contract blob identity verified
no V4 target/performance artifact exists before all prior gates are complete

prediction.alpha_h10: within-date percentile of H10 raw prediction
prediction.alpha_h5: within-date percentile of H5 raw prediction
prediction.rank_population: full frozen decision-time primary-liquid scoring population before future target observability is known
prediction.within_date_score_transform: same average-tie normalized-rank convention as target

challenger_geometry_block.reason_no_missing_indicator: historical Open missingness is partly source/provenance driven and must not become an alpha feature

rank_transform.H10_population: all defensibly H10-observable rows in the frozen decision universe on that date
rank_transform.H5_population: all defensibly H5-observable rows in the frozen decision universe on that date
rank_transform.consensus_rule: compute H5/H10 ranks independently on their horizon-observable populations, then average only on rows where both are observable
rank_transform.population: defensibly target-observable rows inside the frozen decision universe on that date

training_weighting.normalization: sum of sample weights equals N_train_rows
training_weighting.reason: align pooled learner loss with the date-centric product/evaluator while preserving comparable regularization scale

validation.feature_missingness: never drops a training/scoring row; preprocessing handles missing feature values
validation.fold_assignment: selected tail 600 split chronologically into six non-overlapping consecutive 100-session blocks

purge.rule: for validation start official index s, signal sessions s-10 through s-1 are excluded from training; maximum training signal index is s-11

validation.support_refresh_reason: accepted broad ACTIVE census is conservative feasibility evidence but V4-3 freezes a narrower primary-liquid scoring universe; exact >=90% date gates and fold identities must therefore be recomputed outcome-blind on that universe

training_date_sets.H10: all prior H10-eligible primary-liquid dates before the official-session purge boundary
training_date_sets.H5: all prior H5-eligible primary-liquid dates before the official-session purge boundary

validation.training_rows: defensibly target-observable rows for the head on admitted training dates; control and challenger use exact same row identities
